name: paint-border-image
_comment: border-image replaces the magenta border stroke. Gradient slices, fill, outset, a percentage slice, a radial remap, a url 9-slice, repeat, and space. A later border-image-slice longhand overrides the shorthand. No text, so the pixel diff is the slices themselves. pixel_tolerance 2 absorbs gradient and bilinear rounding.
